期待您的参加，祝好运！

notes.title: Winter Sale Kickoff & New Event Preview
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/cad70404dc1412e504ed29e03142478a5c740ebf.jpg  
The heartwarming "Steam Winter Sale" is officially here~! We've brought you year-end discounts across all titles and previews of new activities. Come and check it out——  

❄️ LSP Winter Sale  
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/d3232c503db62198b6320a4694b01336085df636.png  
Explosive discounts spanning Christmas and New Year!  
From December 20 to January 3, you can enjoy special prices on the LSP dating game series. The youth campus romance prose poem *The Roc - 大鹏*, which has received a "Very Positive" rating (50.94%), is now available at a historical low price of 20% off, just ¥19.2!  
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/4ab85a407ffc4117c6c4a596c1adc2832dea1066.png  
❙ Go to the sale venue: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/137689  

⛄ Limited-Time Bundles  

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/ee52910706db5efaf9692e977cbb67893944d127.jpg  
The flower of yuri blooms in shadows—introducing the "LSP Dark Yuri Bundle," available for a limited time. This bundle includes two dark-themed yuri works. During the Winter Sale, get both *The Street of Adrift* and *Dreamless Girl* with a 17% discount. With the sale's additional promotion, you can grab both 2023 releases for just ¥45.  

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48575/LSP_Dark_Yuri_Bundle/  

🎅 [New Event] Game Redemption Qualifications Giveaway  

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/a1dca6f07d24fbfdf3b21d594b8928f578d15a81.jpg  
On December 24 and January 1, we will hold the "Christmas Stockings of the Mascot" and "New Year Lucky Bags of the Mascot" events. During the event, a blind box requiring 3 redemption qualifications will appear at the top of the LSP+1 redemption page. Contents of the blind box are currently confidential. Stay tuned!  

To prepare, we’ve urgently launched a lottery where you can earn redemption qualifications. Join the LSP Lottery now for a chance to win 0–2 redemption qualifications! Users with V3 or above can also participate in a special lottery with a 100% chance of winning at least 1 qualification. You can earn up to 3 qualifications—don't miss out!  

❙ Go to the LSP Lottery: https://www.lspsp.me/lottery  

Happy shopping, enjoy your games, and may good luck always be with you!
